Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You lift a bright hand between your companion and the horror, giving their eyes one steady light to hold.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One visible willing ally within 3 squares, immediately after temporary Frightened or Blinded is applied.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Reduce one of those newly applied conditions by 2, minimum 0. Choose one if both were applied. Existing and starred contributions remain. Your light grants no vision through walls or lasting immunity.
